playOn.label: Play on from the start flag

setAllMarchersToPreviousPageAndFollowing.label: Clear this page (all marchers), later pages move back too

setSelectedMarchersToPreviousPageAndFoll.label: Clear this page (selected), later pages move back too

timelineHoldOverWindow.label: Hold from start flag to playhead

setAllMarchersToNextPage.label: Move to next page's spots (all marchers)

openShapeRing.label: Favorites ring: hold to pick a shape, tap to keep it open

shapeRemoveLastPoint.label: Shape: Remove the last point while drawing

shapeHideMarchers.label: Shape: Hide the marchers (hold to peek, tap to keep hidden)

timelineUnsetHereAndFollowing.label: Remove keyframe, later pages move back too

timelineGoTo.label: Go to a page, measure or rehearsal mark

timelineSplitMoveAtPlayhead.label: Split the move at the playhead

splitSelectedIntoNewMove.label: Split selected marchers into a new move

mergeMoveIntoPage.label: Merge this move into its page
